_comment: ngsolve poisson#4 (VTKOutput cells per element grow as T(2^N) = 2^N(2^N+1)/2, not 4^N). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.3 (24 elements), H1 order 2, subdivision 0 through 3. The measured cells-per-element sequence is exactly 1, 3, 10, 36 -- the claim's numbers -- and each entry equals the triangular number T(2^N) as exact integer arithmetic. 4^N gives 1, 4, 16, 64 and agrees only at N = 0, so the two formulas disagree at three of the four levels and the measurement genuinely discriminates between them; at N = 3 the 4^N estimate over-counts by 1.78x. File sizes 3514/6731/16983/52745 bytes and point counts 72/144/360/1080 both grow, so the cost the formula predicts is real. Mutation: dividing the cell count by 2*mesh.ne instead of mesh.ne shifts the sequence and the fixture fails on matches_triangular_formula.
